Motley Fool's terms permit one intact personal, non-commercial copy but prohibit other storing, posting, and abstracts without prior written permission; source-derived raw and extraction artifacts therefore stay out of Git.

sources.quote: Hyperscale at $38 billion was approximately 50% of data center revenue and increased 12% quarter over quarter. ACIE revenue was $37 billion and grew 31% quarter over quarter including AI cloud revenue that more than tripled year over year.

ACIE: Stands for AI Cloud, Industrial, and Enterprise—a newly defined NVIDIA data center subsegment capturing AI-specialized, non-hyperscale deployments including sovereign, industrial, and regional AI infrastructure.
